Title: Remote file sharing
Subtitle: Connect to a peer and send files after approval.
RoomLabel: Room ID · use the same value on both peers
NetworkHint: Leave STUN empty to test direct connectivity without a discovery server. Peers on different networks may not have a directly reachable address.
Instructions: Connect the receiving peer in Listen mode first, then connect the sending peer in Initiate mode.
ApprovalHint: Transfer starts after the peer chooses a save location and approves.
Ready: Connect to a peer to send and receive files.
InvalidServer: Enter a signaling server URL starting with ws:// or wss://.
InvalidIds: Enter different local and peer device IDs and a shared room ID. (Up to 128 characters.)
InvalidStun: If you use STUN, enter a URL in stun:server:port format.
SessionClosed: The connection closed. Disconnect, then reconnect to try again.
OfferReceived: Your peer wants to send a file. Choose a save location or reject it.
PeerWaiting: Waiting for the peer to initiate a connection.
ConnectionReady: Connected. Either peer can send files. Route: {0}
ConnectionTimeout: Connection timed out. Check the signaling server and whether the peer addresses are directly reachable.
ChooseDialog: Choose a file to send remotely
Sent: The peer saved the file and verified its SHA-256 hash.
CanceledStatus: The transfer was canceled or the connection closed.
SaveDialog: Choose where to save the incoming file
NoOverwrite: Choose a new filename to preserve the existing file.
TestHint: Connect the test window first, then connect this window. The signaling server must be running.
Error.transfer-busy: Another file transfer is in progress.
Error.offer-expired: The incoming file request has expired.
Error.destination-exists: A file with that name already exists. Choose a different name.
Error.receive-open-failed: The peer could not open its destination file.
Error.receiver-canceled: The receiver rejected or canceled the transfer.
Error.receive-failed: The peer could not save or verify the file.
Error.peer-busy: The peer is transferring another file.
Error.Timeout: The peer did not respond in time.
Error.Network: Could not connect to the server or peer. Check the address and network settings.
Error.File: Could not read or save the file. Check the path and access permissions.
Error.Protocol: Transfer verification failed. Reconnect and try again.
Error.Unexpected: The operation could not be completed. Reconnect and try again.
